programme.desc: XXVI Vispārējie latviešu Dziesmu un XVI Deju svētki notika Rīgā no 2018. gada 30. jūnija līdz 8. jūlijam.

programme.title: Iekodies
programme.desc: Arī šī sērija veltīta pilnīgi citādam temperamentam – gruzīniem. Hačapuri, hinkaļi, vīns, Suliko un izslavētā viesmīlība. Latvijā dzīvo vairāk nekā 1300 gruzīnu. Kas viņus atvedis uz Latviju, un ko viņi domā par mums, latviešiem? Jana dosies ciemos pie Mananas uz vienu no vecākajiem gruzīnu restorāniem Rīgā "Ibēriju" gatavot hačapuri. Kad galds būs gardiem ēdieniem klāts, viņām pievienosies Rusudana kopā ar savu mammu un mazo dēliņu īstā gruzīnu tautastērpā. Rusudana spēlē tradicionālos gruzīnu stīgu instrumentus un dzied skaistās gruzīnu tautas melodijas. Vēl viena tikšanās būs kopīgi rīkotā piknikā Rīgas centrā ar gruzīnu Koki Ionatamišvili un latvieti Elīnu Langi, vīru un sievu, kuru savienību vieno dziļa cieņa pret gruzīnu un latviešu tautu un burvīga meitiņa, kas runā gan latviski, gan gruzīniski. Kozmens sāks ar vīru lietām – Imedi Kokaja viņu iepazīstinās ar savu tautastērpu un gruzīnu biedrības darbību Latvijā, mākslinieks Avtandils Ašvetija parādīs un pastāstīs par tepat Latvijā tapušām gleznām, un jaukā "Hačapuri meitene" iemācīs bučoties, kopā gatavojot un baudot gruzīnu tradicionālos hinkaļi.

programme.title: Iekodies
programme.desc: Latvijā teju uz katra stūra ir pa kebabnīcai, un kebaba dzimtene ir Turcija. Vai tas nozīmē, ka pie mums Latvijā arī dzīvo turki?! Jā, viņu nav daudz, bet ir un jau kopš Krievijas-Turcijas kara 1877. gadā. Turki šeit mūs ir iepazīstinājuši ne tikai ar kebabu, bet arī ar turku saldumiem, maizi un turku kafiju Jana dosies uz Valmieru ciemos pie turku šefpavāra Ahmeta viņa restorānā "Ahh-meat". Ahmets mācīs Janai gatavot tradiconālu "Çiğ köfte" un cienās ar grilētu jēra kebabu. Kozmens arī šoreiz gatavos - kopā ar Emrahu īstu turku kebabu tepat, Vecrīgas turku restorānā "Urfa Cafe". Bet turki nav tikai ēdiens. Turki ir lieli dzejnieki, un viens tāds ir tepat Rīgā, pasniedzējs arhitektūras fakultātē Efe Dujans. Efe raksta brīnišķīgu dzeju turku valodā. Viņam izdoti vairāki dzejas krājumi, arī angliski. Kozmens, kā jau vēsturnieks, nelaidīs garām iespēju doties uz Cēsīm, kur Latvijā ieceļoja pirmie turki. Tiesa gan, tie bija karagūstekņi, kas te tika ieslodzīti 1877. gadā Krievijas-Turcijas kara laikā. Bet Jana baudīs - turku saldumus, turku kafiju un turku stāstus par to, kā ir dzīvot šeit, Latvijā, starp latviešiem, ar Latvijas ziemu un mūsu ziemeļnieciski atturīgo temperamentu.

programme.title: Iekodies
programme.desc: Raidījuma "Iekodies" jaunā sezona ir klāt! Turpināsim iepazīt mūsu pašu cilvēkus, kas dzīvo tepat – Latvijā. Šoreiz viesosimies pie Latvijas itāļiem, turkiem, gruzīniem un dziedošās romu tautas. Iepazīsim tuvāk Latvijas pirmtautu – līvus – un viņu kultūras mantojumu un tradīcijas. Daudz gatavosim, sarunāsimies, iemēģināsim roku kādā neparastākā arodā, arī uzdziedāsim un vingrināsim mēli svešādās valodās.

programme.title: Iekodies
programme.desc: Šī epizode veltīta Latvijas pamattautai – lībiešiem. Par tādiem joprojām sevi dēvē 250 cilvēki. Taču jādomā, ka gandrīz katrā latvietī var būt kāda daļa no lībieša un lībiskā, jo šodien dzirdamā latviešu valoda ir veidojusies lībiešu un seno baltu cilšu – latgaļu, zemgaļu un kuršu – saskarmes rezultātā. Jana un Kozmens dosies uz Lībiešu krastu – skaisto jūras piekrasti, kas stiepjas no Ģipkas līča pusē līdz Ovišiem dižjūras malā. 14 ciemi, kur vēl 19. gadsimtā lībiski runāja ap 3000 cilvēku. Tagad šajā senajā valodā var sazināties ap 30, bet lībieši nepadodas. Viņi rīko vasaras skolas bērniem, lībiešu svētkus Mazirbē, sanāk kopā un dzied. Janu pie sevis Kolkas Ūšos uzņems Dženeta, ierādot sklandu raušu gatavošanas pamatus un kopā cepot ziv' un vārot "rūšus". Kad vēders pilns, viņa dosies uz Mazirbes baznīcu iepazīt vietu, kur tika dibināta Līvu savienība, un satikt Teiksmu, kurai pūrā daudzi jo daudzi stāsti un teikas par lībiešu dzīvi šajā pusē. Kozmens brauks jūrā iepazīt tradiconālo lībiešu nodarbi zvejniecību un dosies uz Dundagu satikt lībieti Zoju Sīli. Neviens nezina tik daudz par tautastērpu un lībiešu tradīcijām, kā Zoja. Viņi kopā rekonstruēs teju 200 gadus vecu akvareli, kur redzama lībiešu līgava ceļā no baznīcas. Vakarpusē abi satiks lībiešu ansambļa "Laula" sievas, lai jūras krastā ieskandinātu lībiešu tautasdziesmu.

programme.title: Sirds kā pērkondārds
programme.desc: Komponista, multiinstrumentālista, grupas "Pērkons" radītāja un līdera Jura Kulakova (1958-2024), mūsu izcilā latviešu mūzikas dižgara piemiņas lielkoncertā uz skatuves kāpj Jura Kulakova domubiedri, līdzgaitnieki un sekotāji: grupas "Pērkons", "Menuets" un "Dagamba", "Trīs Latvijas tenori", solists Nauris Puntulis, Rīgas Doma meiteņu koris "Tiāra" diriģentes Aivas Birziņas vadībā, RTU vīru koris "Gaudeamus" diriģenta Ivara Cinkusa vadībā, vijolniece Justīne Kulakova-Sipņevska, flautiste Liene Sējāne, mūziķi Armands Alksnis, Uldis Marhilevičs, Ainars Virga, Jānis Šipkēvics un Liepājas Simfoniskais orķestris diriģenta Andra Veismaņa vadībā. Jura Kulakova devums latviešu mūzikā ir tik bagātīgs, ka paies vēl gadu desmiti, līdz tiks līdz galam apgūts viņa radošais mantojums. Vispirms, protams, viņš ir Pērkontēvs, rokmūzikas urdošais nemiera gars, kura mūzika, šķiet, nākusi tiešā ceļā no mūsu tautas ģenētiskā koda un aiziet tiešā ceļā uz klausītāju sirdi. Tāpēc daudzas Jura Kulakova radītās un grupas "Pērkons" atskaņotās dziesmas nu jau ir kļuvušas par "gandrīz tautasdziesmām". Taču Jura Kulakova ģēnijs ir radījis arī grandiozas kantātes, smalki niansētus kamermūzikas ciklus, rokoperas, mūziklus, elegantu un pārsteidzošu mūziku teātrim un kino, izcilas kordziesmas - viņa radošuma spektrs ir patiesi neaptverams, un katra krāsa tajā mirdz izcili spoža un tīra. Koncerts "Sirds kā pērkondārds" ir Latvijā pazīstamu mūziķu, rokgrupu, koru un orķestru - Jura draugu, radošās dzīves līdzgaitnieku, sekotāju un mācekļu - veltījums izcilajam komponistam, viņa nepieradinātajai un nepieradināmajai dzīvei un mūzikai, kas nu jau paaudzēs iedvesmo, aizrauj, liek just, domāt un būt - būt sev pašam. Dziļa filozofija un smalka ironija, alkaina dzīves mīlestība un smeldzīgas skumjas, bezkompromisa patriotisms, absolūta domas brīvība un bohēmiska neatkarība dzīvē un mākslā - tāds bija Juris un tāda ir un mūžīgi būs viņa mūzika, uz kuras spārniem viņš ir aizlidojis nemirstībā. Tāpēc atcerēsimies Juri tā, kā viņš to būtu gribējis: kopā ar kazu kāpsim debesīs, skumsim svaigā rasā zālē, skaitīsim uguņus uz katra kalna, kur dzīvots, spridzināts un pērkonīgi dārdēts, sauksim "Gulbi, gulbi!" un skaidri zināsim, kas jādara ar rokām tad, kad krauklīt's sēž stabiņā, pašā staba galiņā!

programme.title: Šķērsiela
programme.desc: Pasaules mikromodelis vienā mazā Rīgas nomales ieliņā – Šķērsielā, kur mīl un nīst, priecājas un skumst, raizējas un cer tāpat kā visur pasaulē. Filma "Šķērsiela" tikusi atzīta par labāko Eiropas dokumentālo filmu. Tā ir ieguvusi Eiropas Kinoakadēmijas galveno balvu "Felikss", kā arī daudzu citu starptautisku kinofestivālu balvas, tai skaitā dokumentālā kino klasiķu Jorisa Ivensa un Roberta Flaerti vārdā nosauktās.

programme.title: Jaunie laiki Šķērsielā
programme.desc: Pirmās filmas darbība risinājās Rīgas nomales ieliņā 1988. gadā – laikā, kad Latvijā sākās cīņa par nacionālo neatkarību. Ir pagājuši desmit gadi. Filmas autori atkal atgriezušies mazajā Rīgas nomales ieliņā. Šķērsiela ir kā Latvijas plauksta, kur jebkura zīlniece var saskatīt likteņlīnijas. Šķērsielai cauri izgājuši mērnieki. Zemi kaut kā sadalīja un pārdalīja, bet iemērīt kādam lielāku gabalu dvēseles miera mērnieki, protams, nespēja. Mainījušies ne tikai kaimiņu īpašumi un rocība, citādi ievirzījušās attiecības pat ģimeņu ietvaros.

programme.title: Kapitālisms Šķērsielā
programme.desc: Pagājis kārtējais desmitgades cikls kopš iepriekšējās filmas par Šķērsielu. Pasaules ekonomiskā un psiholoģiskā krīze plosa arī mazo ieliņu. Būtu svarīgi dokumentēt konkrētu cilvēku likteņus dižķibeles laikā. Ne tikai fiksēt bēdīgu rezultātu, kā to dara vairums masu mediju, bet iedziļināties pārmaiņu norisēs kaut vai gada laikā, parādīt ne tikai slīgšanu nabadzībā, bet arī to, kā pārmaiņas ietekmē cilvēku savstarpējās attiecības. Kas notiek pēc individuālisma, norobežošanās un nevienlīdzības uzplaukuma deviņdesmitajos gados, ko redzējām filmā "Jaunie laiki Šķērsielā"? Vai kopēja nelaime vēl vairāk atsvešina ļaudis vai varbūt satuvina? Ņemot vērā, ka dažu kaimiņu vidū agrāk bijuši asi konflikti, būtu naivi cerēt, ka tie izzudīs. Drīzāk tie iegūs jaunu saturu vai arī piemirsīsies un aizies otrā plānā. Viens otrs jau ļaunā priekā noraugās, kā bankrotē bijušie Šķērsielas bagātnieki. Toties citi, šķiet, patiesi aizmirst sīkās ķildas, lai kopīgi izdzīvotu. Ar filmu "Kapitālisms Šķērsielā" noslēdzas triloģija, kuru bez pārspīlējuma varētu uzskatīt par unikālu tautas kinoromānu, kas aptver gandrīz ceturtdaļgadsimtu tautas un atsevišķu varoņu dzīvē, turklāt laikmetu griežos, kas bijuši nozīmīgi visai Eiropai.

programme.title: Rīgai -
programme.desc: Sarīkojums, svinot Rīgas 810. dzimšanas dienu.

programme.title: Kriminālas ekselences fonds
programme.desc: Režisors un scenārija autors: Oskars Rupenheits Krāpnieki, pistole un nolaupīts sunītis - komēdijā "Kriminālās ekselences fonds" Imants Veide raksta scenāriju seriālam par krāpniekiem un kopā ar čomu Hariju Kuharjonoku izmēģina dažādas krāpšanas shēmas. Taču Imants tik ļoti iejūtas jaunajā tēlā, ka pašam sakārojas kļūt par kriminālo autoritāti. Pie apvāršņa parādās veci žuļiki Duļķis un Aļģe, bet lielākais šķērslis ceļā uz kriminālās autoritātes statusu ir Imanta kaimiņiene.

programme.title: Rīga
programme.desc: Ballē skanēs ne tikai Latvijā iecienītais saulgriežu repertuārs, bet arī pasaules deju ritmos aranžētas populāras latviešu dziesmas.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of the Maya
programme.desc: Archaeologists unearth new evidence about the steps that turned the Maya people into a civilization, including clues that elite Maya were beginning to gain power and build cities earlier than once suspected. Archaeologists investigate links between the ancient Olmec civilization and the iconic pyramids of the Maya, revealing the foundations of a society that would endure until the present day.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: SAS Flight #686 Boeing MD-87 October 8th, 2001 A heavy fog blankets Milan's Linate Airport as SAS Flight #686 prepares for a routine flight to Copenhagen. Facing almost zero-visibility, the pilots rely entirely on ground controllers as they navigate into position for takeoff. The plane accelerates down the runway, but as it lifts off it collides with a Cessna in its path. The Cessna erupts in flames. The MD-87 slams to the ground and slides into an baggage hangar. The plane explodes on impact. It is the worst accident in Italian aviation history and the investigation uncovers a shocking series of errors. In the aftermath, an airport is transformed and those deemed responsible are sentenced in court.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Primal Survivor
programme.desc: Hazen Audel, survival instructor and wilderness guide, travels to the most extreme places on earth to take on solo challenges that will push him to the limit of his knowledge, endurance and skills. Battling dense Guyana jungle, parched Kenyan plains and an active volcano in the Pacific Vanuatu islands. To succeed, he will rely on the ancient techniques of indigenous people who have lived in these environments for thousands of years.

programme.title: Primal Survivor
programme.desc: Hazen Audel joins the Evenki in the forests of Inner Mongolia where he learns to ride their highly prized Reindeer and protect them from bears and Lynx through the dark nights. When 2 of the herd go missing, Hazen sets off downstream in his hand made birch bark canoe then crosses deep, mosquito-infested bogs to retrieve them and return them to the herd - all the while, living off the land using traditional Evenki skills to survive.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: A huge winter storm slams into Toronto International Airport. The Airfield Inspector unit urgently tracks down a blown-over sign before it becomes a hazard. The airport is down to one runway as snow ploughs clear the other. They have 15 minutes before snow makes the live runway unsafe. A jack-knifed Boeing 787 throws operations into chaos. Final

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Fire crews race to a plane with faulty brakes, cargo vanishes, and passengers refuse to check bags. Wildlife teams deploy eagles and pyrotechnics to clear the runways, while mechanics battle to keep aircraft flight-ready. As problems unfold behind the scenes at Toronto International Airport, multiple teams fight to keep flights on schedule.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of the Maya
programme.desc: In June 2020, a team of scientists and archaeologists make a discovery that challenges long held beliefs about the origins of the great Maya civilization. Using LIDAR, a technology that allows researchers to locate ruins buried beneath dense vegetation, the team uncovers an ancient site, Aguada Fenix, a monumental structure over 3,000 years old.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of the Maya
programme.desc: Archaeologists unearth new evidence about the steps that turned the Maya people into a civilization, including clues that elite Maya were beginning to gain power and build cities earlier than once suspected. Archaeologists investigate links between the ancient Olmec civilization and the iconic pyramids of the Maya, revealing the foundations of a society that would endure until the present day.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on a 1989 VW Golf GTi, one of the most iconic cars to have come out of the 1980s and one which just happens to be Tim Shaw's all-time favourite car. The boys challenge this time is to make this particular Golf suitable for its owner Darren, a former bus driver who was left disabled and partially sighted after a tragic road accident in which he saved the life of his young grandson.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: In this opening episode, we recount the life of Chinggis Khan, beginning with the dramatic struggles of his early years, including his family's fall from power, his survival against rival tribes, and his first alliances as a young warrior determined to rescue his kidnapped wife, Borte.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: Temujin enlists a childhood friend called Jamuqa. Their close friendship eventually turns into rivalry. Temujin is defeated and is forced to spend 10 years with the Jin Empire. When he returns, Temujin reasserts his position on the Mongolian plains and has subjugated all who oppose him, including his former allies. Temujin takes the title by which he will forever be known: Chinggis Khan.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: In 1953, a US Army scientist working on biological weapons, Dr. Frank Olson, falls to his death from his hotel window under suspicious circumstances. Almost twenty years later, the US government offers Olson's family a $750,000 pay-out, revealing that he died because of his involvement in a secret CIA experiment studying the use of LSD and interrogation—an offshoot of a series of mind control experiments called MK-ULTRA. Go behind the true extent of these secret CIA experiments and their casualties.

programme.title: Inside North Korea: The Kim Dynasty
programme.desc: Unpacking the unique Kim father-son relationship further, "The Son of God" tracks the decline of Kim Il Sung and the rise of his son, Kim Jong Il. Jong is an unlikely successor to his father. He is not a military man - he is obsessed with cinema, particularly James Bond films. "The Son of God" tells the story of how he uses filmmaking and propaganda to win his father's approval - and power. Not only did Jong love James Bond films, but the films influenced his behaviour in trying to immitate a real-life Bond villain. Beginning in the 1970s, this film explores Jong's rise to power as the heir apparent of North Korea, delving into such pivotal incidents as the kidnapping of filmmakers Choi Eun Hee and Shin Sang Ok; the attempted assassination of the president of South Korea; and the terror campaign waged by North Korea, such as the Korean Airline bombing by Kim Hyon Hui, in the buildup to the 1988 Seoul Olympics.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: Tracking the butcher: A father's mission to bring justice to one of the most feared members of the Taliban reaches a turning point when a teenage boy within his inner circle is captured during a raid. With this unexpected breakthrough and the aid of the CIA's most advanced covert tracking technology, agents close in on the elusive figure known as "The Butcher." What began as a distant mission for justice now inches toward a final resolution.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: Trial by fire: A newly appointed director of counterterrorism takes charge of the CIA's controversial enhanced interrogation program, determined to track down those responsible for the Sept. 11 attacks. As the hunt intensifies and moral lines blur, the director faces growing pressure from within the agency and beyond. When the top-secret program is ultimately revealed to the American public, the director must confront the personal and political fallout of choices made in the name of national security.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The world's most famous football team, Manchester United, is on its way back to the UK from the European Championships in Yugoslavia. And after a refueling stop in Munich, the pilots prepare for the final leg of their journey home. In light snow, the aircraft careers down the runway, but just as it approaches takeoff speed, the plane suddenly slows down and, without lifting off the ground, crashes into a nearby house and fuel shed. With 23 people dead, including seven Manchester United players, the high-profile air disaster effectively wipes out one of the best football teams in the world. With the international media clamoring for answers, the German inquiry begins piecing together what went wrong. And when the surviving pilot is blamed for the crash, his struggle to clear his name spans more than a decade and pits one nation against another.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: After taking the title of khan, Chinggis consolidated power by building a formidable army and eliminating rivals like the shaman Teb Tengri. Chinggis began his conquests with bold campaigns against the Tanguts and the Jin Empires, where brutal sieges of the city involved bold new military maneuvers, expanding the Mongol Empire to unprecedented heights.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: When a neighboring empire attacks a Mongol caravan, Chinggis Khan unleashes a devastating campaign that annihilates the empire and solidifies Mongol dominance across the lands of Persia. As his health declines, he names his son Ogedei as his successor and leads one final campaign against the neighboring Tanguts before his death, leaving behind an empire that spans continents.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations in Puerto Rico seized cocaine from an abandoned boat on the beach. In Texas, Customs and Border Protection officers uncovered packages of methamphetamine hidden within pallets from a large shipment of limes. With the drug pouches stuck to the wood, it takes them many hours to retrieve the load. At the Port of Newark, CBP discovers stolen vehicles concealed inside shipping containers about to be sent out of the country.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The real Jason Bourne: A former special forces soldier, now working as a CIA officer, is presented with the rare opportunity to meet face-to-face with a high-ranking enemy Taliban leader. But when a critical and trusted ally unexpectedly goes missing, he finds himself at a crossroads. He must decide whether he should embrace the warrior code and launch a rescue mission, even if it means walking straight into a carefully laid ambush.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Carriers are often defiant towards officials, but crumble in the end. Cases of protest and denial from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. Sisters deny ingesting drugs but break down when one reveals she is pregnant. A drunk man denies the checked bag is his but is arrested and confesses. A young woman claims she is innocent but may have a mental illness. A young man with liquid cocaine in beer lies at first, but then breaks down.

This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The world's most famous football team, Manchester United, is on its way back to the UK from the European Championships in Yugoslavia. And after a refueling stop in Munich, the pilots prepare for the final leg of their journey home. In light snow, the aircraft careers down the runway, but just as it approaches takeoff speed, the plane suddenly slows down and, without lifting off the ground, crashes into a nearby house and fuel shed. With 23 people dead, including seven Manchester United players, the high-profile air disaster effectively wipes out one of the best football teams in the world. With the international media clamoring for answers, the German inquiry begins piecing together what went wrong. And when the surviving pilot is blamed for the crash, his struggle to clear his name spans more than a decade and pits one nation against another.

programme.title: Primal Survivor
programme.desc: Hazen Audel, survival instructor and wilderness guide, travels to the most extreme places on earth to take on solo challenges that will push him to the limit of his knowledge, endurance and skills. Battling dense Guyana jungle, parched Kenyan plains and an active volcano in the Pacific Vanuatu islands. To succeed, he will rely on the ancient techniques of indigenous people who have lived in these environments for thousands of years.

programme.title: Primal Survivor
programme.desc: (DESERT WARRIORS) Hazen returns to the Rendille tribal village where he learned their camel nomad skills and sets out to collect one from the herdsmen camping out way in the Kenyan desert. He avoids creepy critters like the camel spider and snakes, find someone beat him at harvesting honey from wild bees and digs for water. He crosses crocodile-infested Lake Turkana in a canoe. Having passed a strange stones site, he finds the herdsmen not at the corral he expected and much join them elsewhere, then camps with them, fearing scorpions and lions after the animals. He manages to return with one camel, enough for a hungry village to feast on.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Emergency at Toronto International Airport when a flight carrying 80 passengers and crew crashes on landing on runway 23. As the airport goes into an immediate ground stop, cancelling all outbound flights and diverting incoming aircraft, the teams on the ground are pushed to their limit trying to manage the chaos that ensues when you close Canada's busiest airport.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto Pearson International Airport, the sub-zero temperatures push the largest de-icing station in the world to its limits, as snow and freezing ice delay take offs. On the apron, it's a race to free up frozen cargo doors and water pipes. And the team have their hands full with an injured flight attendant, irate passengers and a trespasser in one of the most dangerous areas of the airport.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: After taking the title of khan, Chinggis consolidated power by building a formidable army and eliminating rivals like the shaman Teb Tengri. Chinggis began his conquests with bold campaigns against the Tanguts and the Jin Empires, where brutal sieges of the city involved bold new military maneuvers, expanding the Mongol Empire to unprecedented heights.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: When a neighboring empire attacks a Mongol caravan, Chinggis Khan unleashes a devastating campaign that annihilates the empire and solidifies Mongol dominance across the lands of Persia. As his health declines, he names his son Ogedei as his successor and leads one final campaign against the neighboring Tanguts before his death, leaving behind an empire that spans continents.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: World Eats Bread
programme.desc: In the U.S., where Wonderbread reigns supreme, sourdough goes against the grain -- and nowhere does it better than the counterculture bastion of California's Bay Area. For our bakers, making naturally leavened bread isn't just a career, it's a way to find fulfillment on their own terms. But living the bread life comes with its own challenges.

programme.title: World Eats Bread
programme.desc: In Guatemala, where the ancient Maya believed the gods made humans out of corn, the tortilla is the heart of every meal. But despite its storied history, this humble flatbread and the women who make it have long been taken for granted. Now, a network of chefs, farmers and activists is fighting to give the tortilla its due, and boost their nation's pride in the process.

programme.title: World Eats Bread
programme.desc: The Fertile Crescent is where the seeds of bread were first planted millenia ago - and to this day Turkey eats more of it than just about any other nation. This is the tale of two of their most beloved loaves: simit, the fuel that powers the thriving city of Istanbul, and Ramadan pide, a once-a-year delicacy that represents compassion and generosity - even in trying times.

programme.title: Mars: Inside SpaceX
programme.desc: MARS: INSIDE SPACEX will go inside SpaceX's plan to get humanity to Mars, providing an unprecedented glimpse into one of the world's most revolutionary companies. Filmed over the course of three years - this journey will take us behind the scenes with Elon Musk and his engineers - as they persevere amidst both disheartening setbacks and huge triumphs to advance the space industry faster than we ever thought possible.

programme.title: Mission to the Sun
programme.desc: IN JULY 2018 NASA WILL LAUNCH THE FIRST EVER MISSION TO A STAR. A historic quest to explore the last great frontier of our solar system - the sun. This will be the fastest man made object ever created. A spacecraft that will travel 450,000 miles per hour. It's ground breaking mission, to fly into the "atmosphere" of our star and revolutionize our understanding of it. This documentary will celebrate this world changing event. Exploring the amazing science of our sun and going behind the scenes of the NASA mission to reach it. Timed to coincide with the arrival of the probe into the sun's atmosphere (Nov 2018) and the huge media spike this will create, this documentary will celebrate a key moment in human history, humanities first attempt to touch the Sun.

programme.title: Witness: Disaster in Japan
programme.desc: On March 11, 2011, a 9.0 magnitude earthquake struck 75 miles off the eastern coast of Japan. Almost immediately, tsunami warnings blared, urging residents along Japan's coast to quickly move to higher ground. For the next several hours, residents watched in stunned horror as a series of massive waves slammed into the coast, inundating entire towns and sweeping across the countryside, laying waste to everything in its path. Throughout, amateur videographers, news crews, government agencies, tourists, and countless others were recording the sights and sounds of the unfolding catastrophe. Weaving together their footage, Witness: Japan's Disaster reconstructs the earthquake and tsunami as they happened, entirely through the eyes of those who experienced them.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Every year, flood risks increase. Across the globe, big cities are experiencing giant storm surges and extreme rainfall, overwhelming natural waterways and drainage systems, catastrophes that rewrite the rules for engineers. In Tokyo, a city already prone to natural disasters, giant rivers are being built underground to cope with raging torrents and typhoons. In Spain, the horror of the Valencia floods has taught authorities the importance of early warning systems when infrastructure fails. In New Orleans, the Army Corps has revolutionized storm surge barriers — but it took the worst flood tragedy in US history to rewrite the future.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the Morandi Bridge collapsed in Genova in 2018, it was more than a national tragedy. Its failure was a reckoning for engineers everywhere and a sobering reminder that every structure has a lifespan. In a world of increasing populations, changing traffic volumes and extreme weather events, how can we safeguard new bridges? Engineers for Genova's new bridge met the challenge, focusing on intelligent safety and advanced robotics. As Turkey builds the longest suspension bridge in the world, engineers push the limits with clever innovations, delivering a modern marvel that withstands wild winds, catastrophic ship collisions and Earth's seismic fury.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: November 27, 1987. A 747 Combi is on a routine flight toward South Africa when the cabin begins filling with smoke. Passengers struggle to breathe as crew members attempt to fight a fire in the cargo hold. After the plane disappears in the Indian Ocean, an unprecedented recovery operation is launched to locate and raise the wreckage from the ocean floor. Rumours swirl. Did illegal weapons bring down Flight 295?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: An out-of-control turboprop breaks apart while trying to land at Düsseldorf airport, instantly killing everyone on board. German investigators locate every piece of the wreckage within the huge crash site, then painstakingly reconstruct the entire plane in order to determine what went wrong on board Nuremberg Flight 108. Investigators soon uncover a piece of the wreckage with telltale signs of a lightning strike. And as they dig deeper, find conclusive evidence that the powerful jolt jumped from the fuselage to the electrical system, causing a total power failure that disabled critical instruments and plunged the cockpit into darkness. Faced with a one-in-a-million disaster scenario no one saw coming, the disoriented crew lost control of their aircraft. Investigators conclude there was nothing they could have done to save their plane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: The Lost Tomb of Alexander the Great
programme.desc: Archaeologist Pepi Papakosta is on a mission to find Alexander the Great's lost tomb. Excavating in a public garden in the center of the city he founded 2300 years ago, Alexandria, Egypt, she has discovered a rare, marble statue of Alexander, Greek treasures, and secret tunnels. But Pepi's biggest find is an extraordinary discovery even she was not expecting.

programme.title: Lost Tomb of Genghis Khan
programme.desc: Mongolia is being plundered. Illegal gold mining operations are proliferating across its vast landscape, desecrating its soil and polluting its rivers. The lost tomb of Genghis Khan, Mongolia's best-kept secret and only remaining tie to its spiritual and political forefather, could be unearthed and destroyed at any time. Can American engineer and explorer ALBERT LIN, equipped with cutting-edge technology and just a handful of obscure clues from ancient texts, find and protect the tomb of the Great Khan before it is destroyed? Albert's expedition has the blessing of the Mongolian government, but he has been forbidden to dig. In THE SEARCH FOR GENGHIS KHAN, we join Albert on a quest that seems impossible: to find a body without a shovel, somewhere in a territory that measures thousands of square miles in area. Lin's research leads him to search for a lost mountain-the Burkhan Khaldun-in the heart of the "forbidden zone." But to get there he must first conquer a series of natural obstacles, including an inhospitable landscape, swollen rivers, and violent storms. It is on the Burkhan Khaldun that Lin makes his most remarkable discovery, one that may solve an 800-year old mystery and cause waves in the archaeological community for decades to come.

programme.title: Quest for King Solomon's Treasure
programme.desc: Countless treasure-seekers have set off in search of King Solomon's mines a quest inspired by the Bible's account of spectacular temples adorned in glittering gold and copper. To date, any evidence that supports Solomons existence is regarded as highly controversial. Expeditions in 2010 revealed groundbreaking new clues buried in the Jordanian desert for centuries.

programme.title: Cleopatra's Final Secret
programme.desc: Archaeologist Kathleen Martinez is leading a thrilling detective hunt on land and underwater, to unearth the final pieces of the puzzle that will unlock the story of Cleopatra's last days. Armed with the latest technology and the unparalleled skills of explorer Bob Ballard, she is guaranteed to make extraordinary discoveries. This could be the find of the century: Cleopatra's Lost Tomb.

programme.title: Witness: Disaster in Japan
programme.desc: On March 11, 2011, a 9.0 magnitude earthquake struck 75 miles off the eastern coast of Japan. Almost immediately, tsunami warnings blared, urging residents along Japan's coast to quickly move to higher ground. For the next several hours, residents watched in stunned horror as a series of massive waves slammed into the coast, inundating entire towns and sweeping across the countryside, laying waste to everything in its path. Throughout, amateur videographers, news crews, government agencies, tourists, and countless others were recording the sights and sounds of the unfolding catastrophe. Weaving together their footage, Witness: Japan's Disaster reconstructs the earthquake and tsunami as they happened, entirely through the eyes of those who experienced them.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the twin towers fell in 2001, many engineers thought the era of the skyscraper was over. But the extraordinary catastrophe marked a turning point of a different kind. Safety codes and new understandings were shared internationally, and enthusiasm for tall buildings reached new heights. Construction of supertall buildings — skyscrapers taller than 300 meters — accelerated. Now, there are 71 cities across the world with at least one. Each one, from the One World Trade Center in New York to the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, stands on the shoulders of past failures, hard lessons written in concrete and steel.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Nuclear energy can power whole cities … or level them. Free from carbon emissions and capable of providing baseload power to the existing grid, nuclear is a key tool in the fight against climate change — but the potential for catastrophe is never far from public perception. Despite its reputation, atomic power is one of the safest forms of electricity generation in the world today, thanks to the engineering lessons learned from past accidents. Chernobyl, Fukushima and Three Mile Island have each provided a roadmap to a safer future as atomic scientists work on realizing the ultimate dream: nuclear fusion.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: At 1.23AM on April 26th,1986 a massive explosion rips through reactor number four at Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Soviet Ukraine. A safety test has triggered the worst nuclear accident in history, releasing 400 times more radiation into the atmosphere than the Hiroshima bomb. While control room operators reel in shock, the nuclear plant's firefighters battle the blaze amidst lethal levels of radiation. Just 3km away in the local town of Pripyat, Communist party officials encourage life to go on as normal. Children go to school and couples get married while radiation rains down on them. Meanwhile a giant radioactive cloud starts to circle the globe. Episode 1 follows the first 24-hours of the disaster, with first-hand accounts from people desperately trying to make sense of an accident no one thought could ever happen.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: On 28th April, fire still rages in what's left of reactor number 4. Helicopter crews trying to put it out are bombarded by massive doses of radiation. Soviet authorities finally order the evacuation of local residents, and 50,000 people are forced to leave their homes. They are told to take enough for 3 days, but they will never come back. Frontline firefighters suffering acute radiation burns are locked in wards controlled by the KGB. Many will die within days. In Sweden high levels of radiation alert the rest of the world to a radioactive cloud sweeping across Europe - evidence of a massive nuclear accident in the USSR. But the Soviet authorities remain silent. Episode Two charts the first two weeks after the meltdown, revealing the human cost of the accident, and the Soviet efforts to conceal the true scale of the disaster.

programme.title: Primal Survivor
programme.desc: Hazen travels to Papua New Guinea to meet the Mirr tribe. These hunter gatherers are famed for their rich culture and are fiercely protective of their land and people. Hazen is keen to attend a tribal wedding, but first has to prove himself worthy by heading out into the wilderness alone. He's tasked with bringing back three items for the groom - all essential for the tribal nuptials. But the hostile terrain proves challenging and time is against him.

programme.title: Primal Survivor
programme.desc: Hazen travels to the Malay Peninsula in search of the Mani tribe. These ancient hunter gatherers use traditional blowguns armed with poison tipped darts. Hazen is keen to join a hunt but first he must prove he's up to the challenge by surviving alone in this daunting wilderness. Home to vertical rock cliffs, wild jungle elephents and even tigers, it's a dangerous envoironment where every step could be your last.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Storms across the Eastern Seaboard batter short-haul destinations and ground outbound flights at Toronto International. Inside the terminal, tempers reach boiling point as delays and cancellations mount. Cargo handlers welcome some four-legged passengers as engineers carry out vital maintenance on a Dreamliner 787. Airfield Maintenance teams work around the clock to melt mountains of snow.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Toronto Airport security teams are on high alert as intruders infiltrate restricted areas across the airfield and inside the terminal. A couple of wily coyotes find themselves on an active runway. Gate crew try to hunt down a passenger travelling with a deadly weapon, and there's a medical emergency on a plane just minutes from taking off.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Australia, a continent unto itself…home to scores of creatures found nowhere else in the world. Among this myriad of species is an elite group of twelve --an assembly of animals, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory skills. Brilliantly adapted, beautiful to observe, they enthrall and amaze us. Now, witness their magnificence by journeying to their inner sanctums. From the Great Barrier Reef to the Outback, to the urban jungle, they creep crawl and live where we live, work, and play. The shows climax comes when it reaches the animal whose size, strength or fearsome reputation looms above all others. To best understand these animals, we not only examine the magnificent adaptations that have allowed them to survive and thrive, but hear from someone whos met them first hand…and lived to tell the story. This first-person narrative offers both stunning detail and insight into why this animal is indeed considered one of the deadliest. Theyre beautiful, theyre highly evolved, and theyre dangerousthey are Australias Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Australia, a continent unto itself…home to scores of creatures found nowhere else in the world. Among this myriad of species is an elite group of twelve --an assembly of animals, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory skills. Brilliantly adapted, beautiful to observe, they enthrall and amaze us. Now, witness their magnificence by journeying to their inner sanctums. From the Great Barrier Reef to the Outback, to the urban jungle, they creep crawl and live where we live, work, and play. The shows climax comes when it reaches the animal whose size, strength or fearsome reputation looms above all others. To best understand these animals, we not only examine the magnificent adaptations that have allowed them to survive and thrive, but hear from someone whos met them first hand…and lived to tell the story. This first-person narrative offers both stunning detail and insight into why this animal is indeed considered one of the deadliest. Theyre beautiful, theyre highly evolved, and theyre dangerousthey are Australias Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Examine the weirdest animals that hide deep beneath the soil's surface. A worm explodes from the seabed to yank fish into its mucky pit; a beetle tunnels deep into warm, wet dung; and a miniature digger excavates miles of tunnel with its teeth! Some hunt in swarms to overwhelm living prey, while solo operators rely on disguise and trickery to trap victims. Tunnellers display bizarre and ingenious solutions to survive in cramped, stuffy and dark conditions.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: TV series that captures the wildlife that lives within of Africa. A number of iconic species call the vast biodiversity in this country and help us to understand their natural behaviours in their habitats. Jack Spencer takes us on a journey to look at the amazing communities ranging from a pride of fearsome lions, to a herd of enormous elephants to the smaller insects and everything in between. Each episode has a main focus of one animal group or topic within Africa so for those who enjoy learning about Africa, this programme is for you.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The hyena, much maligned and misunderstood, is no slobbering scavenger. It's a calculating killer: as smart as a primate, as lethal as a lion. Built for the Kill: Hyena follows the transformation of a tiny cub into an accomplished hunter; exposing real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way, the Grumeti and the Mara, each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The killer whale is the world's biggest dolphin-32 feet long and up to six tons heavy. Smart, sophisticated, and social, they live in groups and hunt cooperatively. Built for the Kill: Killer Whale exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The big bad wolf is 100 pounds of muscle and teeth, but it's born blind, deaf and weighs just one pound. Built for the Kill: Wolf follows the transformation of a helpless pup into an accomplished killer, exposing real life-and-death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail. The wolf hones its hunting skills over about two years of intensive training-and the lessons are hard.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbalala rīko lielo talantu konkursu. Katram barbabērnam uz skatuves jādemonstrē savs lielākais talants, nekādas nīkuļošanas! // Videospēles ir jautras, bet jāmāk izbaudīt jauki laikapstākļi. Vecāki izlemj bērniem radīt jautras rotaļas ārā. Bet lomas un mīklas jādala uzmanīgi, lai nerodas pārsteīgumi.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabravo noķer mistisku maskētu vandāli, kurš cenšas bēgt pēc mājas apzīmēšanas. Pie lietas ķeras detektīvs un doktors. // Barbabravo mīļākā mašīna pazūd no viesistabas. To meklējot Barbabravo, Barbabella un Barbagudrais zem dīvāna atrod dīvainu caurumu. Ja nu mašīna aizkrita līdz zemes centram?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Nē! Nē! Tas nav beidzies! Barbabravo nav mazs, viņš ir liels puika! No šis dienas viņš tā arī dzīvos - nekādu snaudu, uzkodu un spēlēšanās ar brāļiem un māsām. // Barbabērni pirmoreiz dodas uz lielveikalu. Tik daudz preču, lieliska vieta! Bet kāpēc viss satīts plastmasas plēvēs?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni laimē skārienpaliktni. Visi grab to izmantot, tāpēc čiepj viens pēc otra.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad komanda uzbūvē īpašu limonādes stendu Lūkasam un Lilija, īgnais Ātrmeistars ieripina to Celtnieklīča ielās. Kāpēc bebrs Krančijs šķērso ceļu? Jo Rabla komanda būvē tiltu, lai palīdzētu viņam nokļūt ceļa otrā pusē.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Celtnieklīci ir pārņēmis noslēpums. Kad pēkšņi pazūd pilsētnieku skulptūra, Rabla komandai pievienojas Čeiss, lai atrisinātu pazudušās statujas noslēpumu... un uzbūvētu gluži jaunu Zinātnes centru, lai palīdzētu izmeklēt.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Celtnieklīcis gaida iemīļotas TV zvaigznes jauno filmu. Bet vispirms vajadzīgs kinoteātris, kur to skatīties! Vectēvs pastāsta suņukiem par apslēptiem dārgumiem. Lai tos atrastu, komandai jāstrādā ķepu ķepā!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Doras palīdzību lūdz košā alebrihe Ale. Alebrihu koks ir novītis, tāpēc Dorai jādodas meklēt varavīksnes ūdens. Karstā dienā visi ilgojas pēc saldējuma, bet Valas furgons ir iestidzis smiltīs! Dora iet palīgā, lai visi tiktu pie aukstā našķa.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda vēlas izcept vi lielāko pankūku! Taču situācija kļūst sarežģīta, kad Ātrmeistars grib visu sabojāt.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un viņa ķepaiņu celtnieku ģimene pārceļas uz kaimiņpilsētu Celtnieklīci, kur viņi dzīvo, rotaļājas un būvē visu kopienai nepieciešamo.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēkšņi pa nakti pazudušas Barbazū skaistās rozes. Viņš ir drošs, ka vainīga Barbabella. Bet kā lai piedabū viņu atzīties? Barbazū viņai iedod jaunu lelli, kas viņu labāk pieskatīs. // Bērni ģimenes albumā ierauga Lolitas bērnības foto. Barbatētis tādēļ nolemj bērniem pastāstīt par to, kā viņš un Lolita reiz devās ekspedīcijā uz Arktiku.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Bērni pirmoreiz brauks ar vilcienu un nakšņos viesnīcā. Mamma būs ar viņiem, bet tētis atsevišķi vedīs paštaisītos izstrādājumus. Viņiem jāpārdod savi darbiņi ikgadējā lielajā tirdziņā, ja tētis paspēs laicīgi... // Uzsniga sniegs un bērni sarīkoja pikošanos, bet Barbabo uzcēla lielisku sniegavīru. programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Daži dzīvnieki ir biedējoši un šķiet bīstami. Tētis stāsta savu piedzīvojumu, kad viņš ar Lolitu kāpa kalnos un satika vilku. // Rīt ir bērnu pirmā skolas diena, katrs gatavojas citādāk. Pirmā skolas diena ir satraucoša, tik daudz par ko jāpadomā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Gabriels rīko Talantu šovu, taču Ātrummeistars izdomā plānu, lai viņš būtu vienīgais dalībnieks. Cetnieklīča svētkos dziedās Sjerra Spīdošā, un vajadzīgi jauni instrumenti.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts

Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas būt divos pasākumos reizē. Tims meklē Kajai uzkodu bez purvzāles. Pēc vairākiem zaudējumiem Tija cenšas uzvarēt visās ballīšu spēlēs.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kucēni ir sajūsmā, kad viņu mīļākā TV zvaigzne Henks Hammers grib redzēt, kā viņi strādā. Kapteinis Turbo ir sagādājis pārsteigumu. Kad saceļas migla, komandai ir jāuzceļ bāka.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kucēni atrod dinozauru kaulus un nolemj uzcelt dinozauru muzeju. Kad Omars salauž kāju, kucēniem jānodrošina rampas, lai viņš tomēr spētu turpināt piegādāt pastu.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Zābaciņš un Dora dodas uz Banānkalnu, lai nogādātu Isai dāvanu - Zābaciņa apgleznotu puķu podu! Dora kopā ar draugiem rīko dzimšanas dienas pārsteiguma ballīti Garnadzim. Ceļā uz svinībām Garnadzis mēģina nočiept pats savu dāvanu!

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: While engaging in a fight with his nemesis, Dr. Eggman, Sonic the Hedgehog destroys the Paradox Prism, an ancient artifact with immense power. This causes a ripple in the space-time continuum, separating Sonic from his friends and sending him to New Yoke City, a dystopian version of Green Hills in a parallel universe ruled by five Eggman variants. Traveling through his new surroundings, Sonic is confronted by Nine, a variant of his best friend Tails who constructed mechanized tails as weapons against his childhood bullies, not having a Sonic to help him. Sonic earns Nine's trust, and the young genius modifies Sonic's shoes and gloves to attune to the new energy in his body from the Prism. However, Sonic and Nine are captured, and Sonic is taken for tests run by Rusty Rose, a variant of Amy Rose turned into a subservient cyborg. When the variants threaten Nine, Sonic overworks his powers, causing him to generate a massive amount of energy. However, he notices what seems to be a hallucination of his rival Shadow the Hedgehog during this surge and flashbacks to an earlier confrontation with him.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

Max, Phoebe, Billy, and Chloe steal a part of the amulet back, and Mastermind goes after them. In order for Chloe to save her friends, she has to reveal her secret identity to them. Chloe teleports herself and the twins back to the cave to return the crystal from the magical amulet. Mastermind follows them, and as he is not a true superhero, the cave refuses to let him have it and captures him, allowing them to take B.C. to the Hero League.

programme.title: Henry Danger

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Nuts to You/The Terror of Madagascar Description : Nuts to You: Fred the Squirrel has hit the jackpot. He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Ar piemēriem vēlamies parādīt, kā cilvēks var, veiksmīgi integrējoties vidē, vadīt savu saimniecisko darbību. Veidot cilvēku izpratni, dodoties Latvijas dabā, izglītojot un informējot iespējami plašu sabiedrības daļu par dažādo ekosistēmu un sniedzot praktiskus padomus, kā izmantot dabas resursus, nepiesārņojot un saglabājot vides kvalitāti.
